review_notes: I read the whole file. It has four theorems and no simp lemmas, simp attributes or simp sets. The statements expand a single Pochhammer evaluation into sums of products (antidiagonal, range and multinomial forms). Tagging any of them @[simp] would be wrong: they would unfold terms and would compete with each other, since the antidiagonal and range forms have the same left-hand side. The proofs use only local simp calls: `simp`, `simp [hma]`, `simp only [...]`, and `simpa [ascPochhammer_smeval_eq_eval]`. I checked Mathlib's `ascPochhammer_smeval_eq_eval` in Mathlib/RingTheory/Binomial.lean. It is a plain theorem and not a simp lemma, so passing it explicitly to simpa is reasonable. I found no missing canonical simp lemma, no unsuitable orientation, no competing rules and no credible cycle. I did not check how other files in the repository use these theorems.
